text: It's amazing. You can choose a bunch of languages, any language actually, and you can even switch to your keyboard if you're not like into talking. Like if you don't want to talk, you can just switch to your keyboard and type. My friends, my parents, my cousins, everyone won't have to wait like five minutes for me to write them a message. I could just talk and send them this message. It's amazing, and it's free too. You should try it. Actually, that's why I rated it five stars.
